class.name: AudioCommand
class.brief_description: One action on an [AudioMixerServer] channel, stored as data.
class.description: An [AudioCommand] describes one audio action, such as playing a stream, toggling a soundboard pad, fading in ambience or jumping to a queue entry, as a resource. Run it with [method AudioMixerServer.execute], or collect many in an [AudioCommandList] and register them with [method AudioMixerServer.register_commands], so they run by name ([method AudioMixerServer.execute_named]) or by group ([method AudioMixerServer.execute_group]). A sound designer or modder can then change what plays when by editing data instead of scripts. All stored properties are flat values (the stream is a path in [member stream_path], not an [AudioStream]), so a command list saves as [code].tres[/code], JSON, INI or CSV with one row per command. In text formats, [member command], [member fade_curve] and [member loop_mode] are written as names (for example [code]Toggle[/code], [code]Fade In[/code]); numbers are accepted when loading. Each command uses only the properties it needs; the others are ignored: - [constant COMMAND_PLAY]: [member stream_path] (empty: the queue entry at the cursor), [member position], [member loop_mode]. - [constant COMMAND_STOP]: [member fade_time]. - [constant COMMAND_TOGGLE]: stops like [constant COMMAND_STOP] if the channel is playing (also when paused), otherwise plays like [constant COMMAND_PLAY]. - [constant COMMAND_ENQUEUE]: [member stream_path] (required), [member queue_index] ([code]-1[/code]: at the end). - [constant COMMAND_DEQUEUE]: [member queue_index] ([code]-1[/code]: the last entry). - [constant COMMAND_CHANGE_INDEX]: [member queue_index], [member fade_time], [member loop_mode]. - [constant COMMAND_NEXT], [constant COMMAND_PREVIOUS]: [member fade_time], [member loop_mode]. - [constant COMMAND_FADE_IN]: [member fade_time], [member fade_curve], [member loop_mode], and optionally [member stream_path] (cross-fades to that stream). - [constant COMMAND_FADE_OUT]: [member fade_time], [member fade_curve]. - [constant COMMAND_CROSS_FADE]: [member stream_path] (required), [member fade_time], [member fade_curve], [member loop_mode]. - [constant COMMAND_SET_VOLUME]: [member volume_db], [member fade_time]. - [constant COMMAND_SET_PITCH]: [member pitch_scale]. - [constant COMMAND_SEEK]: [member position]. - [constant COMMAND_PLAY_ONE_SHOT]: [member stream_path] (required), [member volume_db], [member pitch_scale]. - [constant COMMAND_SWITCH_CLIP]: [member clip_name]. - [constant COMMAND_STOP_ALL]: [member fade_time]; needs no [member channel]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var forest = AudioCommand.new() forest.command_name = &"forest_birds" forest.group = &"forest" forest.channel = &"ambience" forest.command = AudioCommand.COMMAND_FADE_IN forest.stream_path = "res://ambience/birds.ogg" forest.fade_time = 3.0 forest.loop_mode = AudioCommand.LOOP_MODE_ON AudioMixerServer.execute(forest) [/gdscript] [csharp] var forest = new AudioCommand(); forest.CommandName = "forest_birds"; forest.Group = "forest"; forest.Channel = "ambience"; forest.Command = AudioCommand.CommandEnum.FadeIn; forest.StreamPath = "res://ambience/birds.ogg"; forest.FadeTime = 3.0f; forest.LoopMode = AudioCommand.LoopModeEnum.On; AudioMixerServer.Execute(forest); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The name of the [AudioMixerServer] channel the command acts on (see [member AudioMixerChannel.channel_name]). Required by every command except [constant COMMAND_STOP_ALL].
The clip that [constant COMMAND_SWITCH_CLIP] switches to, in the [AudioStreamInteractive] that the channel plays.

The name under which [method AudioMixerServer.register_commands] registers the command, for [method AudioMixerServer.execute_named]. A command without a name can still run directly or by its [member group].
The curve of the fade of [constant COMMAND_FADE_IN], [constant COMMAND_FADE_OUT] and [constant COMMAND_CROSS_FADE]. Use [constant AudioMixerServer.FADE_CURVE_EQUAL_POWER] for cross-fades.

The fade time in seconds. A negative value (the default, stored as [code]-1.0[/code]) uses [member AudioMixerChannel.default_fade_time] of the channel; for [constant COMMAND_STOP_ALL] it means no fade. [code]0.0[/code] acts at once.
A group name, so [method AudioMixerServer.execute_group] runs all registered commands of the group at once, for example all ambience of a level.

Whether the channel loops its current entry. With [constant LOOP_MODE_ON] or [constant LOOP_MODE_OFF], a command that starts playback ([constant COMMAND_PLAY], [constant COMMAND_TOGGLE], [constant COMMAND_FADE_IN], [constant COMMAND_CROSS_FADE], [constant COMMAND_CHANGE_INDEX], [constant COMMAND_NEXT], [constant COMMAND_PREVIOUS]) sets [member AudioMixerChannel.loop_current_entry] of the channel first; the channel keeps that setting.
The channel pitch for [constant COMMAND_SET_PITCH], or the extra pitch of a [constant COMMAND_PLAY_ONE_SHOT]. Must be greater than [code]0[/code] for these commands.
The position in seconds where [constant COMMAND_PLAY] and [constant COMMAND_TOGGLE] start, and where [constant COMMAND_SEEK] jumps to.

The queue entry for [constant COMMAND_CHANGE_INDEX] and [constant COMMAND_DEQUEUE], or the insert position of [constant COMMAND_ENQUEUE]. [code]-1[/code] means the end of the queue (enqueue) or the last entry (dequeue).

The path of the [AudioStream] to play, cross-fade to or enqueue. The stream is loaded on the first [method AudioMixerServer.execute] (see [method AudioCommandList.preload_streams] to load it earlier) and freed when nothing plays it any more.
The channel volume in dB for [constant COMMAND_SET_VOLUME], or the extra volume of a [constant COMMAND_PLAY_ONE_SHOT].

constants.constant: Plays [member stream_path] on the channel, or the queue entry at the cursor if [member stream_path] is empty. See [method AudioMixerServer.play].
Stops the channel. See [method AudioMixerServer.stop].
Pauses the channel. See [method AudioMixerServer.pause].
Resumes a paused channel. See [method AudioMixerServer.resume].
Stops the channel if it is playing, otherwise plays like [constant COMMAND_PLAY]. Made for soundboard buttons.
Adds [member stream_path] to the queue of the channel. See [method AudioMixerServer.enqueue].
Removes a queue entry. See [method AudioMixerServer.dequeue].
Removes all queue entries. See [method AudioMixerServer.clear_queue].
Moves the queue cursor to [member queue_index]. See [method AudioMixerServer.set_queue_index].
Moves to the next queue entry. See [method AudioMixerServer.play_next].
Moves to the previous queue entry. See [method AudioMixerServer.play_previous].
Fades the channel in. With a [member stream_path], cross-fades to that stream instead (on a silent channel this fades the new stream in). See [method AudioMixerServer.fade_in].
Fades the channel out and stops it. See [method AudioMixerServer.fade_out].
Cross-fades to [member stream_path]. See [method AudioMixerServer.cross_fade].
Sets the channel volume to [member volume_db], faded over [member fade_time]. See [method AudioMixerServer.set_channel_volume_db].
Sets the channel pitch to [member pitch_scale]. See [method AudioMixerServer.set_channel_pitch_scale].
Jumps to [member position] in the current stream of the channel. See [method AudioMixerServer.seek].
Plays [member stream_path] once on top of the channel (fire and forget, limited by [member AudioMixerChannel.max_polyphony]). See [method AudioMixerServer.play_one_shot].
Switches the [AudioStreamInteractive] of the channel to [member clip_name]. See [method AudioMixerServer.switch_to_clip].
Stops all channels. See [method AudioMixerServer.stop_all].
Keeps the [member AudioMixerChannel.loop_current_entry] setting of the channel.
Turns [member AudioMixerChannel.loop_current_entry] of the channel off.
Turns [member AudioMixerChannel.loop_current_entry] of the channel on, so the current entry repeats.
